name: parse_bool

source.name: Original
source.modifications: Authored for this experiment as a multi-module configuration package with boolean conversion, defaults, command line parsing, validation, environment helpers and reports.

issue: 解析配置中的布尔值时，任意非空字符串都被当作真值，关闭开关的取值如 false 仍然生效为开启。例如 debug 配置为 false 时，加载结果仍为真。请修复该问题，并保持真值解析、默认值、配置合并、命令行解析、键校验与文本渲染的行为不变。
notes: The converter delegates text to the builtin truth test, which treats every non-empty string as true. The same converter feeds configuration loading, command line options and environment values. Regression tests use true words or non-text values.
